tool_input.description: Experiment to check UTF-16 BOM length calculation

result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/ExtendedBufferedReaderAgentTest.java` with 23 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering `ExtendedBufferedReader`: initial state, single-char and buffered reads (including zero-length, EOF, partial reads, negative offset), `peek()` non-consumption, `readLine()` terminator variants (none, CRLF, blank lines, split-across-buffer CRLF), `mark`/`reset`, `close()` behavior and post-close read failure, and byte-tracking via the charset encoder (disabled by default/flag, ASCII, UTF-16 BOM handling, supplementary characters, and the lone-low-surrogate error case). All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
